checkpoint: physical runtime-steering mechanism proof on Galaxy S25 Ultra

device.workdir: /data/local/tmp/geniexsteeringlab (own namespace; no existing demo package touched)

runtime.stack: forked GenieX geniex-qairt core (branch steering/aux-inputs, base abf961f + commits 68ed0f5/428adc0/afd4afc) built for aarch64-android with NDK r27c

model.kind: tiny LLM-shaped steering-capable context pair (mirrors tests/testing/llm_fixture.hpp tensor set)
model.math: logits = (input_embeds + alpha * steering_vector) @ W + eps*ReduceSum(attention_mask); KV passthrough slices
model.compiled_with: QAIRT 2.45.41 x86_64-linux qairt-converter + qnn-context-binary-generator offline HTP prepare (dsp_arch v79, soc_model 69), in WSL — one-time compile; never recompiled during value changes

results.stock_equivalence: no-aux run and alpha=0 run produced identical logits (checksum -31.0908, argmax 14)

numerical_validation.method: device delta logits(alpha)-logits(0) vs exact fp32 alpha*(vec@W); mask term cancels

results.no_recompile_no_reload: all sweeps ran inside one process against one loaded context (load_count 1, reload_count 0); alpha/vector changes were pure runtime tensor writes

conclusions: Runtime-variable activation-steering inputs flow end-to-end through forked GenieX (GenerationConfig::aux_inputs -> AuxTensorInputProvider -> Graph::write) on physical HTP v79.
Both prompt (prefill) and decode graphs receive the values each execution.
alpha=0 is bit-identical to stock unsteered execution.
Changing alpha or the vector changes actual NPU outputs with fp16-level agreement to the analytic reference.
known_issue: current geniex-qairt (abf961f) fails to LOAD the QAIRT-2.45-era AI Hub Qwen3-0.6B bundle ('vector' out_of_range during init) — reproduced with UNPATCHED baseline auto_llm, i.e. a stock incompatibility predating this fork; the full-Qwen semantic proof needs a fresh AI Hub export.
